name: Mysuru Dasara (Nada Habba)
short_description: Karnataka's official state festival featuring royal palace illuminations and grand elephant procession.
cultural_significance: Celebrates Goddess Chamundeshwari's victory over Mahishasura. Preserved by the Wadiyar Dynasty.
history_origin: Initiated in the 14th century by the Vijayanagara Empire and institutionalized in Mysuru in 1799.
major_attractions: Jamboo Savari (750kg Golden Howdah Elephant Procession)

dos: Arrive 2 hours early for Jamboo Savari seats
donts: Do not use single-use plastic inside palace grounds
Avoid flash photography near procession elephants

name: Hampi Utsav (Vijaya Utsav)
short_description: Grand cultural extravaganza celebrating Vijayanagara architecture, dance, music, and light shows.
cultural_significance: Honors the golden era of the Vijayanagara Empire with performances amidst UNESCO World Heritage ruins.
history_origin: Revived by the Government of Karnataka to celebrate historical architectural grandeur.
major_attractions: Light and Sound Show at Stone Chariot & Virupaksha Temple
Classical Dance performances by national artistes

dos: Carry sun protection during daytime temple walks
donts: Do not climb on ancient stone sculptures or monuments

name: Kambala Buffalo Race
short_description: Thrilling traditional coastal slush track buffalo race demonstrating rural athletic vigor.
cultural_significance: Deeply rooted in Tulunadu agrarian traditions dedicated to Lord Kadri Manjunatha for good harvests.
history_origin: Practiced for over 800 years by coastal farming communities of Dakshina Kannada and Udupi.
major_attractions: Koli Anke and Coastal Folk Music
local_food: Kori Rotti (Chicken Curry with Rice Wafers)

dos: Stay behind spectator safety barricades near mud tracks
donts: Do not attempt to touch racing buffaloes

images.caption: Kambala jockey driving buffaloes across slush track

name: Bengaluru Karaga Shakthyotsava
short_description: Night-long spiritual procession led by the Karaga bearer carrying a floral pyramid pot without hands.
cultural_significance: Celebrates Draupadi as Sakthi. Represents inter-community communal harmony between Hindus and Muslims.
history_origin: Centuries-old festival of the Thigala community centering at Dharmaraya Swamy Temple.
major_attractions: Visit to Hazrat Tawakkal Mastan Dargah

dos: Maintain silence during sacred sword ceremonies
donts: Do not obstruct the Karaga bearer's movement
Avoid using camera flash directly at bearer

name: Pattadakal Dance Festival
short_description: Classical Indian dance performances set against the backdrop of 8th-century Chalukyan rock-cut temples.
cultural_significance: Showcases classical Indian dance forms (Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Odissi, Kuchipudi) at a UNESCO heritage site.
history_origin: Organized annually by the Department of Tourism to honor Chalukyan architectural heritage.
major_attractions: Crafts Bazaar and Stone Artisan Exhibitions

dos: Arrive before 5:30 PM for good seating
Carry warm jackets for winter evenings
donts: Avoid phone ringtones during dance recitals
